transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?
I'm here because I've been dealing with persistent exhaustion and constant worry for about 10 months now. I just feel completely drained of energy and can't seem to find any relief.
Did these symptoms start after a specific stressful event or major life change, or did they come on without a clear trigger?

I'm really not sure of any specific stressful event or major life change that started all of this. It feels like the exhaustion and worry just crept up on me gradually over the last 10 months without any clear trigger.
For most of these past 10 months, have you been feeling down or depressed most days, or is it mainly the worry and exhaustion?

It's definitely been mainly the constant worry and the overwhelming exhaustion. I wouldn't say I feel down or depressed, but I just feel completely drained of energy all the time from worrying so much.
Along with the worry, have you also been feeling restless, tense, irritable, having trouble concentrating, or having sleep problems?

I definitely feel a lot of physical tension and have trouble concentrating, especially since my neck, shoulders, and jaw always feel stiff and knotted. My mind often goes blank or gets easily distracted by my worries, though I don't really experience irritability or sleep problems.
When the worrying starts, do you find it hard to control or stop it, even when you try?

Yes, absolutely. Once the worrying starts, I find it incredibly difficult to control or stop, even when I actively try to distract myself or calm down. It feels like my mind just takes over and I can't turn it off no matter what I do.
Do you find yourself worrying about many different parts of life, like work, health, finances, or family, rather than mainly one specific issue?

Yes, exactly. My worries aren't limited to just one thing; I find myself constantly worrying about almost everything, including my job, family, finances, and even minor daily matters. It really feels like I can never catch a break from these thoughts.
Have these worries and physical tension been interfering with your work, relationships, or daily activities?

Yes, they definitely interfere with my daily life and work. I find it extremely difficult to focus on my tasks because worries constantly surface and scatter my attention. On top of that, the persistent lack of energy makes it really hard to carry out normal daily activities.
Have you started any new medications, used caffeine or other substances heavily, or had any medical problems like thyroid issues that might be contributing to the anxiety?
No, I haven't started any new medications, and I don't drink much caffeine or use other substances. I'm also not aware of having any medical conditions like thyroid issues.
